title: Classifiers
description: Services that score items against categories the requesting app supplies with each request, chosen per kind of item with a fallback, and how much detail apps may share with each. A score is advice; it never authorizes an action.

document.title: Document classifier
document.description: Classifies documents such as PDFs and office files.

fallback.title: Fallback classifier
fallback.description: Used for any kind of item without its own classifier, for items of other kinds, and when the classifier for a kind cannot classify an item.

textDetail.title: Detail shared with the text classifier
textDetail.description: What apps may send with each item: minimal sends only the item and its format; standard adds its language; full adds where it came from and the app's context tags. Unset means minimal.
